description: "History of the United Netherlands from the Death of William the Silent to the Twelve Year's Truce" by John Lothrop Motley is a historical account written during the late 19th century. The book chronicles the tumultuous period in the Netherlands following the death of William the Silent, focusing on the political and military struggles that culminated in the siege of Antwerp and the broader conflict with Spanish rule.
